free_tier.stated: Vendor: 'Register and use altHUB without paying first. Upgrade later if you want higher limits.' A third-party table describes the free side as a '14-day trial: 5,000 downloads and 5,000 API calls' and lists AltPRO USD 5/year and AltUNLIMITED USD 10/year.
free_tier.notes: The vendor promises a free start without a number; the only number is third-party and describes a trial. Both readings are recorded because they lead to different verdicts.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: not published on the pages reachable today; a third-party table claims '900,000+ NZBs from 80 newsgroups indexed'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the API returns pointers.

interface_detail: Newznab API. The site's own pages advertise 'Fast API', 'Works with SABnzbd and NZBGet, using the same API your client already speaks' and a response-time claim. An unauthenticated /api?t=caps returned 403 with text/plain, so the API refuses anonymous callers.
tooling: Native Newznab, explicitly built for SABnzbd and NZBGet; Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 add it with URL plus key.
chaining: At USD 5/year it is the cheapest paid escape from a 25-call free tier; the free start is what makes it worth trying before paying.

limits.value: 5,000 API calls and 5,000 downloads during a reported 14-day trial
the plans page is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so the allowance a free account actually keeps after a trial was not readable

binding_note: A daily counter is the only kind of limit this service has been reported to run, and the free side is either generous (5,000) or time-boxed (14 days). Which of those is true decides whether it binds at all.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is open: /register serves username, password, confirm and email fields, with no invite field and no card.

reliability_note: The domain moved from althub.ovh, which now returns a Cloudflare 530 to every request; a saved config pointing at the old host fails at DNS, not at auth.
confidence_note: The registration form and the 403 on the API were observed today. The allowance is third-party because the plans page is challenged.

evidence.proved: vendor text read: 'Fast API', 'Free to start - Register and use altHUB without paying first. Upgrade later if you want higher limits.'
registration form with username, password, confirm and email; no invitecode field
unauthenticated caps returned 403 with text/plain, so the API rejects anonymous callers
the plans page returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' interstitial (403); a pinned browserless retry also failed
third-party: 'Open registration', 'AltPRO USD 5/year, AltUNLIMITED USD 10/year', '14-day trial: 5,000 downloads and 5,000 API calls'

notes: The old spelling altHUB.ovh is still circulating in lists; it answers 530, which reads like a dead service and is not one.
